# CryptoRot

> Static analyzer for Python that finds weak or retiring cryptography and gives each finding a fix-by year. Exports a CycloneDX 1.6 CBOM, SARIF 2.1.0, JSON and CSV.

CryptoRot is proprietary software. Copyright (c) 2026 Rohitkumar V Navalgund. All rights reserved. Contact: rohitkumarvn155@gmail.com

## Pages

- Check your code: paste Python or pick a folder and read the findings.
- Projects: 20 open-source Python projects scanned at pinned commits. Each has a report and a findings list.
- Benchmark: the method, the numbers and the limits, including the precision on the labelled set.
- Self-test: 82 mutant programs and 10 controls used to check the scanner.
- How it works: one finding explained step by step.

## Facts that matter

- Every finding carries a due year and a cited standard, not a score.
- Findings are labelled proven, probable or heuristic, and as source, test or example code.
- Labels on the benchmark findings come from a single reviewer and have not been independently checked.
